## Project Tracker 1.0.0

First Android preview release of the minimal, neon-acid project tracker.

### Included
- Three-screen flow: project list, project naming, and a project progress ring.
- Add, edit, and delete milestone percentages and notes; progress markers recalculate from the milestone list.
- Rename or delete projects, add an optional deadline, undo the last progress change, and review history.
- Local Android milestone reminders with notification permission support and reboot restoration. Android may delay delivery to conserve battery; reminders are not an alarm-clock replacement.
- Project data stored locally on the device.

### Install
Download `Project-Tracker-debug.apk`, transfer it to an Android device, and allow installation from that source when prompted. This is a debug APK, not a Play Store release.

### Known limitation
The transparent home-screen widget from the original brief is not included in this version.
